<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Leadership confirmation:</strong> Congress leader K C Venugopal announced that Rahul Gandhi will lead the INDIA bloc in the 2029 Lok Sabha elections, effectively ruling out other contenders.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxQaW5Na0lkMGgwWXlDWW5nc3VSLWlsXzQtNW9PT1hBQnNCc0NKZVZ3QllrV01fQWFsQmYwYzE5R1Y0bUxUREtCVTRCUUI2NG51T1RUMGRFWHZxVjRSaFl5VmczbWExRzVDcWVsV0kwYTAzZHc0VC1YQUlULXd2VFBQem1uT1BDSjIyR2J4Q2JkWWVCNU1NS0tFOTExMWFjbHY4cE1HYm1B?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I19</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>High-level appointments:</strong> President Droupadi Murmu appointed former Uttar Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Dinesh Sharma as the Lieutenant Governor of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legislative developments:</strong> Parliament passed the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Amendment Bill, 2026, following its approval in the Rajya Sabha.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxNbHd4NmNKeW5jRGJuOWQyX1dTYk1tVVNoWVZMblY0Ti1BeDl0d1VSeEFZejA5ODd3c1E2Wl80VzB3VVJyUnpLN3VXVk40UURYTGpjTXJNZmxXWGpDQ2tCVFkzNDBfbFl3cThVZUxXamtlVm5pS2l0WTBZdFRFNWZTc0FIUURyZw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Women&#x27;s reservation status:</strong> The Lok Sabha held discussions on three bills aimed at providing reservation for women in the Lower House and State Assemblies, though the constitutional amendment currently faces legislative hurdles.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxQVDU5LUlvTFllUllCbmcyeXlpZUJwdl9TMXlvS3lXXzc4NnpyXzlnd3hjNGNOalkweUpNVHZOYWVQWC1JUkdIeHIta0RNZmZVdENJNUd4a1lwZVJGS2c5RGN4MnZQVWR1bElRMlNUSjlrTVV5dHM1RGd1b1pESWZCbFRvbk1Wc29wOWhteGE5cmNrR2daTWktdkVjU2M4dmlEUVdoYnU0Y2RxRUYzN2x5ejNDY2tBZw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Governance discourse:</strong> Prime Minister Narendra Modi, speaking at SRCC, highlighted India&#x27;s transition from a period of &quot;policy paralysis&quot; to one of &quot;policy dynamism&quot; over the last 13 years.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxORTVUOGRPLXY0YnNLd24xOXAta3cxVklkNWJMU2hjTTNPbEhRV0VCMHJWTzZBQzNDWnJLbURnd0Z5ZkoyZjh6Mmg2UmlRRVBJZUU4SnpENGgzNkFqekk1dmpUaUlTdUl6Snl6THVVZUFiYzNpaWs3TVIzSWpDWXh0bkk5LXM2VkxSbmhyZmlMUEg4aHZUZnBqOUh1SVRxUWV0ZjBtclZZZ21zSFJ4U2Z3?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
</ul>
